profile.headline: Senior / Staff Backend (with some Front End) Software Engineer| Java, Spring, Fintech, Postgres
profile.summary:
Results-driven software engineer with over twenty years of Java experience and computer science generalist skills. Proven background developing high volume OLTP enterprise systems with a genuine passion for quality work, good communication and for fostering a positive work environment.

Skills
Enterprise Technologies: Java, Spring, concurrency, middleware (Spring, Hibernate), SQL databases (Oracle, MySql), UNIX scripting (Bash), Build,Test, Deploy, and Monitor (Maven, Jenkins, JUnit, Splunk)

Web Technologies: HTML, CSS, jQuery, Node, Express, React, Sass/Less, Mocha/Chai, Jest 
Methodologies and Techniques: Agile, continuous integration, test driven design and development,
performance tuning, refactoring, complex system integrations, security and sensitive data handling

Experience with: Encryption, Application Security, Financials, Docker, Webpack, Redux, Babel, C++, STL, Boost, Python, Make, GTest

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Designed, developed and maintained a production ecosystem for user management, financial account management, financial data, authorization, permissions, customer facing applications and critical legacy systems.
Improved identity systems (Oath2, Spring Security, OPA) to help transition system from a single single advisor to multiple advisors with team support per firm.
Supported and maintained legacy production systems while also developing new user and account management features.
Data modeling, performance tuning and optimization for both code and database activities. Mentored and assisted other team members in onboarding, code reviews, debugging, feature design and implementation.
Advised business and architecture on short term tactical wins with great ROI as well as on long term plans and goals for improving advisor and client experiences.
Integrated Plaid APIs to support importing external accounts for a better advisor and client experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Distributed Systems · SQL · Debugging · Software Development · technical Interview · postgres

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
All development activities were full cycle including development, testing both unit and integration, monitoring, and support all within an Agile process.
Developed ledger and securities (note, loan, payment) microservices in Java, SQL (Oracle, MySql, Aurora), Spring, and AWS that handles billions of dollars of assets and hundreds of millions of transactions per day.
Developed systems to calculate and display Net Annualized Returns for all 100k+ investors factoring in inconsistent legacy data and secondary market gains and losses with Java batch processing and Oracle complex queries, analytic functions and query optimizations. 
Front end development for internal microservice tools and the customer facing application funnel that handles hundreds of thousands of applications each year using an end to end AWS database / Java / Node / Express / React stack.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Designed and implemented the first generation of the Out of Network System that allowed direct account to account transfers from member banks to non-member banks using just email or phone numbers. Integrated across several different platforms using web services, Spring, Oracle, JMS, shell scripting and legacy banking systems. Built front end for both mobile and desktop using HTML 5, jQuery and Javascript.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Designed, implemented and tested an image search system for a well known media company using Java, Spring JDBC and Spring Batch, Python, Maven, Oracle, CXF, Axis, Soap, XMLBeans, XPath and Wicket as part of a team.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Manager
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Senior developer on a EJB3 e-commerce and content distribution for a system with tens of thousands of active users with $40 million in annual revenues. 
Performed operational duties, rolling out new software into production, batch updates of production MySql databases, trouble shot scaling and complex configuration issues.
Development responsibilities across the system including html/css styling, Javascript, JSP, security management, business logic and object relational mapping, specialized SQL design, queries, SEO, testing and integration with third party software.
Managed a heterogeneous team of front end engineers and project managed across the whole team from December 2009 onwards.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff, Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Maintained and enhanced time shifting voice conferencing system using Hibernate, Spring, Java Sound and the Grizzly UDP server.
Developed new C++ VIOP-like network protocols using STL and Boost, across multiple platforms.  
Integrated Google Test framework across development.
(early departure due to company funding issues)

positions.title: Travel
positions.description: International travel 6 months: Egypt, India, Thailand, Cambodia, Laos, Philippines

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Company is Ofoto (a subsidiary of Kodak Inc.) based in Emeryville, CA 
Designed and implemented shopping cart upgrade for main and mobile sites that featured credit card caching and an improved user experience, including integrating an address verification system which dramatically reduced missed shipments and their associated costs. The shopping cart was responsible for $100 million in annual sales.
Developed APIs and documentation for a developer program similar to Flickr using both SOAP and REST.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Designed and implemented Web Services for Remote Portlets (WSRP) consumer and producer services using Apache Axis with Vignette Application Builder (VAB) and Vignette Application Portal (VAP).
Designed and implemented a portlet creation tool that constructs easy to use user interfaces around complex web services using .NET, JAP, XSLT, SOAP and a custom XML schema parser.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Designed and implemented data visualization software used during the 2000 Sydney Olympics, built using Java applets, servlets, and XML for data, metadata and configuration information.    
Rewrote inefficient device drivers to work with Java code for real-time data collection devices.  
Developed software for ruggedized Windows CE field data collection devices used in Himalayan climbing expeditions.
